youtube.title: Why Charles Dickens blocked Hans Christian Andersen 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Hans Christian Andersen told Charles Dickens he'd stay for two weeks. He stayed FIVE. 🪞💀

The worst houseguest in literary history, as a group chat.

What's the longest a guest ever stayed at your place? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Andersen's real 1857 visit to Dickens' home in Kent. After he left, Dickens pinned a card on the mirror: "Hans Andersen slept in this room for five weeks — which seemed to the family AGES!"

#hanschristianandersen #charlesdickens #literature #historymemes #history #books #shorts

hook.say: He said he'd stay two weeks. He stayed five. Charles Dickens was not okay.
